headline: GTM readiness audit completed: 3 critical gaps mapped to 9 remediation tasks with owners, effort estimates, and go/no-go metrics by June 25.

primary_stat.label: Audit Coverage
primary_stat.value: Business Model (3 gaps) + Messaging (3 gaps) + Launch Infrastructure (1 gap) = 7 remediation tasks across 6 functions

highlights: Business Model Gap: Credit-burn rate from pilots, independent WTP study (15–20 leaders), win/loss pricing data — 28–40 hours effort by June 25
Messaging Gap: Documented framework, resonance testing in discovery calls, 3x playbooks (email/landing/deck) — 18–28 hours effort by June 25
Launch Infrastructure Gap: Analytics dashboard seeded with real pilot data by June 20 — 2–3 hours effort (dependent on pilot launch)
Execution Roadmap: 3-phase sequence (Phase 1: Prep, Phase 2: Validation, Phase 3: Synthesis) with parallel task execution and clear dependencies
Success Metrics: Business model (gross margin ≥65%, WTP acceptance ≥50% at $24K), Messaging (resonance ≥4/5, playbooks approved), Analytics (≥50 real events by day-5 pilot)
Team Effort: ~93–136 hours across 7 roles (Product, Sales, Finance, Content, Research, Data, Discovery) over 3-week execution cycle
Risk Mitigation: Contingencies for low WTP acceptance, poor message resonance, delayed pilots, and unavailable sales team resources

next_actions.label: Phase 1: Kick off messaging framework documentation (3–5 hrs) + begin discovery calls with embedded resonance testing

args.title: Document Messaging Framework for Branded Fit

Phase 3: Create messaging playbook (email, landing, deck) based on discovery call synthesis + WTP insights by June 25
